how: Requested signed out. Figma's oEmbed endpoint returned the file's title and a thumbnail. The embed URL below loaded in headless Chrome from a local page and was clicked through: ready, unit open, pick a bag, baggage offloaded, pick a bag. The embed redirects through www.figma.com before it shows the prototype.
label: Illustrative screens, not the real system. The process and the checks are simplified, and flights, tags and units are invented.

screens.caption: Unit open
screens.alt: Handheld screen, unit open: AKE 41207 ZZ for flight ZZ 301 to LHR, departs 14:35, Economy, 23 bags. Buttons: Scan bag and Close unit.

screens.caption: Load
screens.alt: Green screen with a tick: LOAD. Right flight, right class. Tag ZZ 214893, ZZ 301, Economy. Place it in AKE 41207 ZZ; 24 bags in this unit.

screens.caption: Do not load: wrong flight
screens.alt: Red screen with a cross: DO NOT LOAD. Wrong flight. Tag ZZ 214877, booked on ZZ 305 to Manchester. Send it back to sortation.

screens.caption: Do not load: baggage offloaded
screens.alt: Red screen with a cross: DO NOT LOAD. Baggage offloaded. Tag ZZ 214851. An offloaded bag cannot be loaded into a unit.

rules.finds: No check-in record for the tag
The bag is booked on another flight
The bag’s class doesn’t match the unit

criteria.given: a unit open for ZZ 301, Economy,
criteria.when: a loader scans a bag checked in for ZZ 301, Economy,
criteria.then: the screen turns green, shows LOAD and counts the bag into the unit.

criteria.given: a bag that has been offloaded,
criteria.then: the screen turns red, shows DO NOT LOAD and Baggage offloaded, and the bag is not counted into the unit.

criteria.given: a tag with no check-in record,
criteria.then: the screen turns red and sends the loader to the problem-bag desk.
